f.title: Establish a pharmacovigilance system and report safety information to the Egyptian PV Center
f.statement: Pharmaceutical and biological product companies and marketing authorisation holders shall establish a pharmacovigilance system and implement its activities to monitor the safety of their products and report safety information to the General Administration of Pharmacovigilance (Egyptian Pharmacovigilance Center), in accordance with the decree's regulatory guidelines and related guidelines issued by that Administration.
f.legal_basis: EDA Chairman Decree No. 354 of 2026, Art. 3
f.applicability: Pharmaceutical and biological products registered in Egypt

f.title: Appoint a qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance
f.statement: Companies and marketing authorisation holders shall also appoint a qualified person responsible for the pharmacovigilance system within the company, in accordance with the decree's regulatory guidelines and other related guidelines issued by the General Administration of Pharmacovigilance.
f.legal_basis: EDA Chairman Decree No. 354 of 2026, Art. 3
f.applicability: Pharmaceutical and biological products registered in Egypt

f.title: Conduct post-marketing efficacy/safety studies on request of the PV Administration
f.statement: Upon request of the General Administration of Pharmacovigilance, companies and marketing authorisation holders shall conduct post-marketing (efficacy/safety) studies within the specified timelines and according to the methodologies and standards approved by the Administration, ensuring continuous evaluation of the safety and efficacy of their products.
f.legal_basis: EDA Chairman Decree No. 354 of 2026, Art. 3
f.applicability: Pharmaceutical and biological products registered in Egypt

f.title: Keep following the current Egyptian GVP guideline until the new one is issued
f.statement: The currently applicable Egyptian regulatory guideline for Good Pharmacovigilance Practices remains in force until the new GVP guideline (to be issued by the Head of the Central Administration of Pharmaceutical Care within five days of the decree coming into force) is issued.
f.legal_basis: EDA Chairman Decree No. 354 of 2026, Art. 4
